name: #TogetherWeHack
content: Problems and Purpose #TogetherWeHack (Span.#LoHackeamosEntreTodos) was a hackathon organized by civil society and the private sector with the aim of searching for initiatives and solutions to decrease the negative effects of the pandemic in Argentina.During the hackathon, participants were able to join presentations and working groups.Background History and Context Organizing, Supporting, and Funding Entities Participant Recruitment and Selection The hackathon had 3 editions in which more than 900 people with different backgrounds participated, including programmers, graphic designers, data scientists and health professionals.Methods and Tools UsedHackathonWhat Went On: Process, Interaction, and Participation The participants organized working groups focused on the following fields: technology and society, technology and health, and technology and information. The result of the hackathon is the design of projects, which the work teams can, if they have an interest and it is feasible, continue developing so that they are implemented. The hackathon’s website describes the 21 projects developed along the first two editions.
